submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 with a threshold of 36 GeV is recommended as it achieves the highest signal efficiency (92.625%) among all three candidate algorithms across the allowed threshold range (20-60 GeV). This represents a significant improvement of 6.5 percentage points over Algorithm-L2 (max 85.524% at 40 GeV) and 17.9 percentage points over Algorithm-L1 (max 74.165% at 30 GeV). The threshold of 36 GeV was determined through a fine-tuning scan around the initial optimal value of 30 GeV, yielding an additional 0.555 percentage point improvement. All constraints have been verified in previous steps: the algorithm is listed as a candidate, complexity level 3 confirms it is deployable in Level-1 trigger hardware, the threshold falls within the required 20-60 GeV range, and the allocated trigger rate of 8 kHz is satisfied. This recommendation achieves the stated goal of maximizing signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
